title: Referral links entered a small Markdown experiment
summary:
A small referral experiment changed how some Markdown replies point people to Pollinations, while two community-made image tools joined the directory.

Up to 1% of eligible Markdown text responses can turn existing product or concept mentions into as many as three referral links. Plain text stays untouched, and processing errors leave the original response intact. A new /referral route records the linked topic before sending visitors to pollinations.ai after three seconds.

The community project listings gained Anime AI Generation, an anime character maker, and @hrisjeui’s AI Image Generator, which offers multiple models, adjustable settings, and a real-time preview.

OpenAI-format responses now get a newly generated ID and creation timestamp. The response helper also no longer fills in missing choice indexes or adds its previous cache header.
